integrity: Standalone proof and reproducibility code included. Numerical checks corroborate finite instances but do not certify universal or asymptotic statements.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two real linearly independent columns, Gaussian row sketch, one sketched-norm pivot and one-column projection; exact arithmetic and expectation over the sketch. No independent audit or general multi-column guarantee. The selected 2025 source has verified first-public date 2025-03-24.
title: Sharp two-row mean-square guarantee for Gaussian-sketch pivoting with two columns
